color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist. Light register: pageBackground #ffffff (luminance 255). Apple's palette is ideal for Bauhaus: pure white background, primary colors as structural vocabulary (blue #0071e3, red #e30000, yellow #ffe045), high-contrast near-black text #1d1d1f.

type-system.twistDescription: Bauhaus/Constructivist transformation: Mathematical type scale (ratio 1.414) — 120, 84.84, 60, 42.4, 30px. Mechanical weight gradient 900→800→700→600→400. Replaced serif fonts (Playfair Display + Lora) with Bebas Neue (headings, geometric display) and Barlow (body, geometric sans). Eliminated ALL letter-spacing from headings — architectural purity, no ornament. Both Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Linear Mechanical: All easing replaced with linear — constant velocity, no acceleration curves. Industrial precision. Durations: 0.12s fast, 0.25s base, 0.5s slow, 0.4s entrance, 0.06s stagger. New keyframes: slideFromLeft (horizontal linear slide), constructBar (width 0→100% constant rate), gridReveal (4-step opacity staircase for structural disclosure).

grid-system.twistDescription: Asymmetric 5-column Bauhaus construction: grid-template-columns 1fr 2fr 1fr 2fr 1fr. Visible 2px column gaps render as structural lines — the grid armature is a first-class visual element. Utility classes: .bauhaus-bar (full-width 8px structural rule, grid-column 1/-1), .bauhaus-sidebar (De Stijl left-rail with 4px border), .bauhaus-diagonal (rotate -12deg), .bauhaus-bleed (breaks container padding).

spacing-system.twistDescription: Golden Ratio Scale: 8px base × 1.618 ratio. Scale: 8, 13, 21, 34, 55, 89, 144px (Fibonacci approximation). Every measurement traces to one mathematical constant. Section: 89px/55px, button: 13px/34px, nav: 13px/34px, card: 21px padding, container: 55px/34px. Pure Bauhaus structural thinking — no arbitrary values.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Press Displacement (Bauhaus mechanical): Active state uses transform: translate(2px, 2px) — simulating physical button press. Transition: 0s on press (instant), 0.15s linear return. Focus ring: 2px solid outline, zero offset — hard-edged mechanical indicator. All hover transitions 0.15s linear. Zero color changes from source. Rejects organic curves.

nav-system.twistDescription: Bold Structural Bar: 56px height, 4px solid black bottom border — the nav is an architectural boundary, not a ghost overlay. Barlow 700 uppercase at 0.75rem/0.08em letterSpacing. Always visible, no scroll transition, no backdrop filter. Item spacing 40px. Check C: fontFamily 'Barlow' is present in assembled type system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted from institutional trust (centered, gentle, photographic) to Bauhaus structural pedagogy. Grid becomes visible structure. Photography replaced by geometric diagrams and type specimens. Asymmetric off-axis layouts replace centered symmetry. Primary colors (blue/red/yellow) deployed as structural vocabulary. Concept: design school/workshop collective. 3 video placements: workshop hands-on (10s), grid construction time-lapse (10s), Bauhaus archive footage (10s).

A_colorContrast.notes: navText #1d1d1f (brightness ~30) vs navBackground #ffffff (brightness 255) — high contrast. bodyText #1d1d1f vs pageBackground #ffffff — maximum contrast.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Hover transitions 0.15s vs motion base 0.25s — ratio 1.67×, well under 5× threshold. Both use linear easing — stylistically unified.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: nav.json fontFamily 'Barlow' is present in assembled type system (ds-type-nav-font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif). No fix needed.
